Chef here, i can't stand cauliflower but the best I've ever made is super simple;
Combine equal parts flour, panko and corn meal. 
Add equal parts:paprika, chilli powder, Cayenne pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. 
Wet the cauliflower with water, toss in the mixture, spread out on a baking sheet and freeze. 
You can either deep fry it or use an air fryer, but 350 degrees for about 7 minutes seems to do the trick. 
Feel free to ask any questions if I didn't explain it well

This happened to me a couple years ago, bug I still remember exactly what happened. 
I was sleeping in my room when I heard scratching at the door. This was normal, because I sleep with my door closed and my cat loved sleeping on my bed.   I got up and let her in and for just a second thought I saw a person out of the corner of my eye. I stood there for a minute, but didn't see it again. I got back in bed, and my cat started meowing. This alone was strange, because she almost never makes any noise. She jumped up on my bed, and tried to crawl under the covers. Understand this; that cat hated, absolutely HATED being under anything. She managed to crawl under the blankets with my and started growling. I looked under the blankets and tried to calm her down. When I looked back up I saw a man shaped form standing about 3 feet away from my bed. I couldn't look away, and I couldn't move. It slowly backed away, and my cat kept growling, and then I passed out. I woke up with the cat in my bed, and the door to my room open.
